cumleler: Why can hearing recover after loud noise?
Stereocilia are joined by very fine filaments called tip links.
Each link works like a spring pulling an ion channel gate open.
Very loud sounds can break these links.
The links can re-form within hours.
This is thought to help temporary threshold shift recover.
